sources.title: IFLA-UNESCO Public Library Manifesto
sources.author: IFLA / UNESCO; 2022 overview
sources.sections: Overview of libraries as institutions supporting education, culture and information
sources.supported_use: Recognize public institutions and inherited shared resources.
sources.limits: Overview only; linked manifesto PDF not inspected. No local budget, labor, donation rule or environmental data.

sources.title: Branches of the U.S. government
sources.author: USAGov; updated March 2, 2026
sources.sections: Federal legislative, executive and judicial roles and checks
sources.limits: U.S. federal context only, not universal/local allocation of service, budget or court powers.

sources.title: State and local governments
sources.author: USAGov
sources.sections: State/local government, elected-official and election-office directories
sources.supported_use: Find actual official routes before inferring authority.
sources.limits: A directory is not a determination of office powers, election eligibility, deadline or complaint jurisdiction; no real inquiry was submitted.

sources.title: Library Advisory Board
sources.author: Pima County, Arizona
sources.sections: Mission to advise on library policies, services, programs and operations
sources.supported_use: Distinguish an advisory board from a decision-making body.
sources.limits: Only advisory mission used; no branch-hours or budget authority inferred. Fictional Cedar roles are not Pima roles. The separate library.pima.gov route returned no substantive body and is not claimed inspected.

sources.title: Universal Declaration of Human Rights — full version
sources.author: United Nations (1948), reproduced by Council of Europe Compass
sources.type: primary declaration in an official intergovernmental reproduction
sources.sections: Full text; relevant equality, fair-process, thought/expression/association and duty provisions
sources.supported_use: General dignity, consistent rights and duties as civic concepts.
sources.limits: The successfully inspected text is the Council of Europe reproduction. Direct UN/OHCHR routes were blocked. General declaration principles do not determine local enforceability, a venue rule or a legal outcome.

sources.title: State and Local Governments
sources.author: U.S. Department of Justice, ADA.gov
sources.sections: Program access, reasonable modifications, communication and existing facilities
sources.supported_use: Consider institutional access barriers alongside individual circumstances.
sources.limits: U.S. Title II context only; not an actual compliance finding, inspection or universal law. No current web deadline or technical standard imported.

sources.title: What does a Living Room Conversation look like?
sources.author: Living Room Conversations
sources.sections: Conversation agreements on listening, respect, responsibility and differences
sources.supported_use: Represent another view with care while preserving differences.
sources.limits: Guidance, not empirical effectiveness evidence or a claim this exercise reproduces an official program. Linked research was not inspected.

sources.title: Writing volunteer role descriptions
sources.author: NCVO; last reviewed April 12, 2021
sources.sections: Purpose, tasks, boundaries, support, accessibility and expectations
sources.supported_use: Make a requested contribution specific and sustainable.
sources.limits: England context; no employment-law rule imported. Role clarity does not prove benefit or validate the invented output/rework accounting.

sources.title: Supported Decision Making Program
sources.author: Administration for Community Living; modified July 17, 2023
sources.sections: Person-chosen assistance tailored to decisions while retaining control
sources.supported_use: Support chosen task-specific help without broad takeover.
sources.limits: No legal capacity assessment, power over credentials, form eligibility judgment or evidence of exercise effectiveness.

sources.title: Chapter 8, Section 5: Developing an Action Plan
sources.author: University of Kansas Community Tool Box
sources.sections: Selected action-plan sections: actions, responsibility, timing, resources, communication and updating
sources.supported_use: Connect an accepted plan to coordinated work and review.
sources.limits: Selected sections only, not every linked chapter. Planning is not impact; a participant does not automatically represent absent users. Original noticeboard case, not the source case.

sources.title: SIFT (The Four Moves)
sources.author: Mike Caulfield; June 19, 2019
sources.sections: Original article through its conclusion; comments excluded
sources.supported_use: Pause, investigate source context and trace claims to better evidence.
sources.limits: Article only, not linked courses or empirical validation. The attempted DIG index supplied no substantive curriculum and is not a source.

sources.title: Ostrom Design Principles
sources.author: Ostrom Workshop, Indiana University
sources.sections: Introductory discussion of institutions/rules developed by resource users
sources.supported_use: Attend to governance and user participation around shared resources.
sources.limits: Overview only; not the full book, eight-principle exposition or Nobel lecture. Attempted Nobel PDF was blocked. No universal design recipe or proof of ecological effects.

sources.title: Sustainable Materials Management: Non-Hazardous Materials and Waste Management Hierarchy
sources.author: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency; updated December 19, 2025
sources.supported_use: Consider suitable reuse while recognizing context-dependent choices.
sources.limits: No calculated waste or climate benefit, hazardous-cleanup advice or environmental restoration claim. Treatment and disposal instructions are not imported.

sources.title: UNESCO Universal Declaration on Cultural Diversity
sources.author: UNESCO; adopted November 2, 2001
sources.sections: Articles 2 and 4: plural participation and human-rights limits
sources.supported_use: Coexistence can preserve differences without justifying rights violations.
sources.limits: General declaration, not a local constitutional rule or evidence that the reading-room intervention works.

sources.title: SPJ Code of Ethics
sources.author: Society of Professional Journalists
sources.sections: Accuracy/context, harm, independence and transparent accountability/correction sections
sources.supported_use: Check public claims and match corrections to responsible roles.
sources.limits: Voluntary principles, not legally enforceable rules or a guarantee that any outlet complies or a claim is true.

sources.title: Disclosure Standards
sources.author: American Association for Public Opinion Research
sources.sections: Methods, sponsor/producer, population, questions, sampling, dates, mode and precision disclosures; page identifies April 2021 code version
sources.supported_use: Ask what a survey report actually establishes before broadening its claims.
sources.limits: April 2021 version on the inspected page, not a claim of a freshly adopted universal standard. Disclosure or membership does not establish representative results, legal compliance or causal impact.
